Current bus feed supplies exact S1759. These support only a coarse public airport-facility gateway relation; no exact frontage asserted.

airportIdentity.currentPassengerAccessReview: Coarse whole-airport gateway only. The official 2025 village transport plan includes the airport route. Bind only the exact licensed native GTFS stop S1759 to the whole C28 airport facility. No door, curb, bay, platform, accessibility, or proximity claim.
